cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Communications Expert position within COO. The posting describes communication as an enabler of performance, helping people make sense of change and understand what to do next. That perspective matches how I have approached my work: turning complex information into clear, actionable content that supports real outcomes.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I handle SEO content and CMS publishing for client websites, coordinating with colleagues to ensure consistent messaging across pages and blog posts. I also build and maintain websites for organisations such as a pharmacists' association, where I created a consistent layout for around 600 member profiles. As a freelancer, I designed and optimized sites for clients including a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data and running iterative audits that measurably improved search health. These projects required close collaboration with stakeholders, careful attention to accuracy, and a focus on making complex topics accessible.

I bring solid experience in translating business priorities into communication plans, managing projects end to end, and using analytics and feedback to refine content. I am fluent in English and have working knowledge of Dutch and French, which allows me to adapt messages for different audiences. While my background is in digital marketing, the core skills of clear writing, stakeholder coordination, and continuous improvement align closely with this role.

I would welcome the chance to contribute to the EX & Communication team, starting with the Fraud portfolio and supporting broader COO domains. Thank you for considering my application.

Kind regards,

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok
